Official government notice identifies the Hami Real Estate Registration Center at the Yizhou District Natural Resources branch registration hall. This is local registry/procedure evidence, not parcel geometry evidence.

Official local regulation states that real-estate registration institutions should provide online and on-site registration-information query services. The page did not expose an anonymous map, feature endpoint, schema, or geometry response.

Official Hami surveying plan describes completion of a third national land-survey database management system and construction of a land-space information platform / one-map supervision system. It provides institutional and platform context, not a public anonymous parcel feature route.

Official 2021-2035 Hami spatial plan states that a unified digital spatial base map is maintained from land-survey data and that data sharing is being improved. It contains no public parcel geometry service.
